strings.en: Defeat all enemies
All allies defeated
So this is the Nanbara Connection. Earthling forces are nothing much.
I don't see why Mother is so concerned.
Hm, what's that? So you've finally come, Campbellians!
That Gandor warship hasn't come, it seems. How dull.
Very well, attack!
Old man! Can't we launch yet!?
Yeah! I ain't gonna sit here and get crushed!
Just a little longer... a little longer. I'm doing the final tuning now.
Doc, never mind the little details! If we don't launch soon...!
I've contacted the Gandor Team... They'll be here soon. Wait.
Rushing out and failing to combine would be pointless...!
The Gandor Team... the only working Federation unit right now, right?
I wish they'd hurry... We won't make it.
...Dr. Yotsuya! This is the Federation Far East Branch, Gandor Team.
I'm Commander Hazuki! We'll take up direct defense of the base!
Thank you! We'll soon be able to launch our battle robot too!
Speak of the devil... Heheheh, saves me the trouble of searching.
I'll dispose of you all at once!
Commander! More enemy robots not in our records.
Dr. Yotsuya, what is this army...!?
...The invasion the late Dr. Nanbara foretold... The Campbellians.
More aliens!? What the hell is going on?
According to Bright, nothing's come down from space lately...
so does that mean they've been hiding here all along?
Save the debate for later. All units, launch!
Still not ready, old man!?
...The Battle Machines' weapons and such are still largely unfinished...
Once we combine it won't matter! Doc, give us the launch order!
...All right, Battle Machines... launch!
All right! I've been waitin' for this!
Let's go!
Yeah!
Yes!
Commander Hazuki, launching Combattler V now...! Please cover it.
Understood. We'll be counting on the power of electromagnetic energy.
Here we gooo!
Let's...! Coooombiiiine!
Combattlerrr V!!
Bring it on, Campbellians! I'll smash every last one of you!
Five machines combining!?
Even Dancougar and Dangaioh only use four. How extravagant.
As long as they're reliable, I don't care!
Whether they're reliable is another matter. Let's see what they can do.
Those guys!?
...YOUR... POWER... WE... WILL... U...SE...
...A voice again!? Hibiki, did you hear that!?
A voice? No, Raideen didn't pick up anything.
...Only me...? It seems it wasn't my imagination after all...
I see, these are the ones Mother spoke of... Then no need to attack.
These are the ones that appeared in Tokyo.
But last time it was just those bony ones.
Right. It's the first time I've seen that red unit.
...KYO...SUKE...
(What!? It just said my name...!)
It said Kyosuke, didn't it...? What's going on!? Kyosuke!?
(Hm? That voice... everyone else can hear it too...?)
Yes... so you are... Kyosuke...
Who are you! How do you know my name!
My name is Alchemie... Einst Alchemie.
Einst... Alchemie, you say?
A girl's voice?
I see... it's you. The woman in the red unit Excellen mentioned...
...Kyosuke... Excellen... question...
What are you talking about?
What are you doing! We're in combat!
Your opponents will be these Einst Knochen.
Anyway, focus on wiping out the enemy for now!
What...! Gaaah! Reduced to this by mere Earthlings!
Withdraw!
Hey, get back here!
Commander, do we pursue!?
No need to chase them far. We know too little about the enemy.
Let's wait and see for now.
Dr. Yotsuya is right.
Just mop up whatever forces are left.
A little... understanding... Kyosuke... but still...
...Who are you? Why don't you make yourself clear?
Answer me.
...We'll... meet again. My... Kyosuke...
(Excellen...!?)
That one felt... different from the bony ones... Why?
Einst... Alchemie... Who on earth is she...
(And... does she feel like Excellen...?
What is there between her and me...?)
It seems we drove them off. Commander Hazuki, I ask once more...
would you take the Combattler Team into the Gandor Team?
Dr. Yotsuya... I don't mind, but if the Connection is attacked again...
I don't think you'll be able to hold them off.
That's right, old man. Don't push it, we'll stick with you.
Exactly right. Doc, don't try to act tough...
Fools! Don't get cocky!
The Campbellians aren't our only enemy!
Unless we unite all of Earth's forces, we won't survive!
Doctor...
Even if the Connection is destroyed, we'll still have you.
That's why Dr. Yumi and Dr. Saotome left their labs empty
and put their super robots in the Gandor Team.
He's absolutely right.
Looks like you've got a good commander.
Hyoma, let's fight with the Gandor Team.
That seems the quickest way to protect the Connection, and Earth.
Hyoma... let's go.
...All right. Commander Hazuki, Combattler will lend a hand too.
Thank you, I'm counting on you.
...Dr. Yotsuya, I'll take good care of the Combattler Team.
Yes, please do. You kids, give it your all...!
Still, what were those bony enemies...
The girl in the red unit worries me, too.
Einst Alchemie...
and she called the bony ones Einst Knochen...
The Einst Series, I guess. What the hell are they?
The Einst Series... What's their objective...?
We have no time to stand still.
Once supplies are loaded, we head to our next destination.
